title: system-rackmounts-proof-rides-the-live-bus-marked
intention: system_rackmount's proof drives the instance's live bus through bus_client instead of standing up a private BusDevice from the cairn device, and every name it puts on that bus (the device it stands up, the inboxes it subscribes) carries the mark 'testing-20a97889646e-'.
why: RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): every component talks to another only through its public interface; a device's is the bus; a ticket's build lives inside its own component and its proofs and hollow measure only that component. Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, extended 2026-10-04): the live system is the test surface; every test output carries a testing mark so it can be thrown away. cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py:54 imported BusDevice from the cairn device to stand up a private scratch bus — one of the encapsulation_breaches measured 2026-10-05.
traces_to: RULE 1 (Akien 2026-10-01); test-against-live ruling (2026-09-28, 2026-10-04); ticket 8e3474a6ae43 falsifier clause (3)
how: cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py: the BusDevice import becomes bus_client (plus address and instanceizer.ensure); _rig wraps bus_client.reach() in a _TestingBus that declines wire_delivery (no shim answers to a testing device id, and a test shim must never drain the live system_rackmount's mail); the device takes device_id 'testing-20a97889646e-sysrm-<8hex>'; subscriber addresses become per-run testing folders with a DataRecorder instanceizer (so the bus files the poke instead of bouncing it), removed at close. The exact diff rides this ticket's build_patch field. One new proof, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount_rides_the_live_bus.py, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) no encapsulation_breaches row has a file under cairn/devices/system_rackmount/; (2) with bus_client.reach wrapped to record, the end-to-end tooth of cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py posts at least one envelope through it, every post names sender and addressee starting 'testing-20a97889646e-', and every read names such an addressee; and all 7 teeth of cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py stay green. RED if any fails or a testing folder outlives the run. WRONG INTENT if the system device's probes cannot be exercised on the live bus without touching the live device (then the proof needs a bus verb on system_rackmount, not a local instance).

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply to cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It is the whole build; nothing else in cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py changes and no other file changes.

D2: SETTLED: the proof cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount_rides_the_live_bus.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 0/2 at HEAD 96a2e924 (2026-10-05: one reach cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py:54 -> cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus.bus; the end-to-end tooth posted nothing through bus_client.reach()). It is committed at the BUILDME crossing; D1 turns it green and does not edit it.

D3: SETTLED: after D1 run `python3 cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py` (exit 0, 7 PASS) and `python3 cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount_rides_the_live_bus.py` (exit 0, 2 passed), then `ls ~/.cairn/folders | grep -c testing-20a97889646e` prints 0. Measured exactly so on a prototype of this diff, 2026-10-05.

D4: SETTLED: commit cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py alone with message '20a97889646e: system_rackmount's proof rides the live bus, marked as testing' and the two trailer lines 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JrhBQALF5qFBEVqQJUsXUu'; the pre-commit reseal door reseals. No file outside cairn/devices/system_rackmount changes.

D5: SETTLED: the testing mark is the convention 'testing-<ticket id>-' on every name the proof puts on the bus; the stamp that would make it physics (origin: test, ticket 71d1bbfa98b0) is not built yet and is not this ticket's — the peer ordered it next, after this pilot. The _TestingBus wrapper is not a simulator: post, read and every other call go to the live bus; only wire_delivery is declined.

D6: SETTLED: the proof cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount_rides_the_live_bus.py is already committed at 31e41009 (2026-10-05), before the build begins; git status shows it tracked. The build commit stages test_system_rackmount.py alone.
